name: 10mcj-bot
description: Telegram bot for preparing 10 Minutes with Jesus messages and media.

scripts.test: bun run build:test && bun --no-env-file --bun run mocha --require reflect-metadata "build-test/test/unit/domain/**/*.test.js" "build-test/test/unit/service/**/*.test.js"
scripts.test-repos: bun run build:test && bun --bun run env-cmd -f .test.env -- bun --no-env-file --bun run mocha --require reflect-metadata --require ./build-test/test/support/mongodb.hooks.js "build-test/test/**/repo/**/*.test.js"
scripts.test-services: bun run build:test && bun --no-env-file --bun run mocha --require reflect-metadata "build-test/test/unit/service/**/*.test.js"
